 Versus

Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Abhishek Anthwal, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. There is no representation for the respondent￾contemnor.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has moved 
Misc. Application (IA No.1 of 2026) which he is not 
pressing and the same is accordingly dismissed as not 
pressed.
4. Misc. Application (IA No.2 of 2026), is an 
impleadment application, has been filed by the 
petitioner seeking to implead the new incumbent￾Sipan Kumar Garg, Managing Director of the T.H.D.C. 
who has joined after the death of earlier respondent￾Mr. R.K. Vishnoi.
5. The impleadment sought for is formal in nature.
6. Accordingly Misc. Application (IA No.2 of 2026) is 
allowed.
7. Let necessary amendment be incorporated by 
supplying amended memo of parties within a week.
8. Issue notice to the newly impleaded respondent￾contemnor returnable within four weeks.
9. Steps to be taken within three days. 
10. List this case on 25.08.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
